info.title: Remi
info.description:
Temporal memory server: remember, project, query, and maintain an agent memory graph.

Authorization is a single static service bearer token, configured with --token, --token-file, or the REMI_TOKEN environment variable, and presented as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The server makes one binary authorization decision: hold that service-administrator credential, or be refused. It does not introspect central tokens and does not differentiate scopes per route, which is why every /v1 operation declares x-tempera-required-scope `admin` rather than a narrower memory:* scope. Narrowing this requires central token introspection, which the server does not implement.

Every response carries an x-request-id header; a valid client-supplied value is echoed. Errors are google.rpc.Status envelopes with a google.rpc.ErrorInfo detail whose domain is remi.tempera.dev. 401 carries WWW-Authenticate; 429, 503, and 504 carry Retry-After.

servers.description: Default bind address of a locally served memory server.

get.description: Report that the process is running and able to answer HTTP. This probe never touches the database and is never authenticated.
Report whether the service can serve database-backed traffic. Returns 503 with the same body shape, not an error envelope, when the database is unhealthy, saturated, or slow. Never authenticated.
Fetch deep store health: schema identity, SQLite integrity, and graph consistency, together with the store statistics.
Fetch memory-store row counts: ledger events, pending events, nodes, edges, and retained audit events.
Fetch in-process service counters as JSON. Served from memory, so it stays available while the database work queue is saturated.

get.summary: Get service metrics in Prometheus text format
get.description: Fetch the same counters in Prometheus text exposition format for scrape-based monitoring. Served from memory.

200.description: Service metrics in Prometheus text exposition format.

get.description: List recent durable service audit events, newest first. Page tokens are opaque, checksummed, and bound to the page size that minted them.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Events per page, 1 to 500. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: The nextPageToken from the previous page.

post.description: Write one memory event into the tenant and project ledger, and by default project pending events into the memory graph before returning.
Project pending ledger events into the memory graph and return the projection report.
Answer a scoped memory question with evidence, contradictions, stale assumptions, and reconstruction metadata.
Run one bounded local maintenance pass: WAL checkpoint, optional VACUUM, optional orphan repair, and optional audit retention pruning.

bearerAuth.description: The static memory-server service bearer token.

Status.description: The google.rpc.Status error envelope required of every Tempera API (AIP-193).

code.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body so the envelope is self-describing.

status.description: The canonical google.rpc.Code name, for example INVALID_ARGUMENT.

message.description: A developer-facing description that is safe to log and safe to show.

details.description: Structured error details. Present but empty when there are none.

requestId.description: The server-assigned request identifier, mirrored from the x-request-id response header.

LiveResponse.description: Liveness probe result. The process is running and can answer HTTP.

status.description: Always "ok" while the process is serving.

ReadyResponse.description: Readiness probe result, including the outcome of the database health check.

status.description: "ok" when the service is ready, otherwise "not_ready".

message.description: Why the service is not ready, or null when it is ready.

StoreStats.description: Operational row counts for the memory database.

pendingEvents.description: Ledger events not yet projected into the graph.

nodes.description: Memory nodes in the projection graph.

activeNodes.description: Memory nodes that have not been invalidated.

GraphIntegrityReport.description: Projection-graph integrity counts not covered by SQLite foreign keys.

orphanEdgesFrom.description: Edges whose source node no longer exists.

orphanEdgesTo.description: Edges whose target node no longer exists.

orphanNodeSpans.description: Span rows whose node no longer exists.

orphanCueIndexEntries.description: Cue index rows whose node no longer exists.

StoreHealth.description: Deep store health: schema identity, SQLite integrity, and graph consistency.

applicationId.description: SQLite application_id read from the database file.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version read from the database file.

expectedSchemaVersion.description: The schema version this build expects.

integrityOk.description: Whether PRAGMA integrity_check reported no problems.

integrityMessages.description: Raw integrity_check output when it is not simply ok.

ServiceMetricsSnapshot.description: In-process service counters since the server started.

startedAtUnixMs.description: Unix milliseconds when this metrics window started.

rateLimitedRequests.description: Requests rejected by the per-actor rate limiter.

dbBusyRequests.description: Requests shed because the database work queue was full.

dbTimeoutRequests.description: Requests that exceeded the database task budget.

failedRequests.description: Requests that produced an error response.

metricsRequests.description: Requests to the two metrics routes.

occurredAtUnixMs.description: Unix milliseconds when the event was recorded.

actor.description: Stable hash of the presented bearer, "anonymous", or "unauthenticated".

action.description: The logical operation, for example remember or query.

route.description: The HTTP route that produced the event.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code returned to the caller.

detail.description: Free-form JSON detail; never raw memory text.

AuditHttpResponse.description: One page of service audit events, newest first.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

MemoryNodeKind.description: Typed memory node families in the projection graph.

MemoryMode.description: Which memory substores a query may consult.

MemoryTier.description: The highest retrieval tier used to produce an answer.

ReconstructionReason.description: Why a query did or did not escalate into active reconstruction.

ProjectReport.description: Result of one projection pass over pending ledger events.

eventsProjected.description: Events applied to the projection graph.

memoriesInvalidated.description: Memory nodes invalidated by newer belief.

RememberHttpRequest.description: One memory event to append to the tenant and project ledger.

text.description: The memory text to distil and project.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen key that collapses retries of the same write.

project.description: Project pending events before returning; defaults to true.

RememberHttpResponse.description: Result of appending one memory event.

ingested.description: False when an idempotency key collapsed the write.

project.description: The projection report, or null when projection was not requested.

ProjectHttpRequest.description: Bounded request to project pending ledger events.

limit.description: Maximum pending events to project; defaults to 1000.

MemoryScope.description: Tenant, project, environment, and as-of bound for a memory query.

asOfUnixMs.description: Answer as the memory stood at this Unix millisecond.

QueryHttpRequest.description: A scoped memory question with an optional retrieval budget.

requireFresh.description: Refuse memories invalidated before the as-of bound.

reconstructionMode.description: Active reconstruction policy; defaults to off.

CitedSpan.description: Span provenance for a returned memory.

seq.description: Position of the span within the trace.

Evidence.description: One compact evidence item that can be placed into model context.

nodeId.description: Memory node the evidence came from.

citedSpans.description: Spans this evidence was distilled from.

Contradiction.description: A contradiction surfaced instead of silently collapsed.

summary.description: What the two memories disagree about.

StaleAssumption.description: A premise that may be stale under the requested freshness.

nodeId.description: The memory that may be stale.

invalidatedAtUnixMs.description: When the premise was invalidated, if it was.

ReconstructionReport.description: Diagnostics for a bounded active reconstruction pass.

acceptedNodeIds.description: Nodes the pass kept as evidence.

MemoryAnswer.description: An answer with the evidence and reconstruction metadata behind it.

answer.description: The composed answer; empty when nothing was recalled.

citedSpans.description: Every span cited by the evidence.

staleAssumptions.description: Premises that may be stale under the as-of bound.

tokenEstimate.description: Estimated tokens the answer and evidence cost.

MaintenanceHttpRequest.description: Options for one local maintenance pass.

pruneAuditBeforeUnixMs.description: Delete audit events older than this Unix millisecond.

retainLatestAuditEvents.description: Keep at most this many of the newest audit events.

GraphRepairReport.description: Rows removed by graph integrity repair.

AuditPruneReport.description: Rows removed by audit retention maintenance.

MaintenanceReport.description: Result of one local maintenance pass.

walCheckpointLogFrames.description: Frames in the WAL at checkpoint time.
